h1: Hop Inn Chaengwattana — Clean Budget Rooms Near the Pink Line, a Short Walk to CentralPlaza Chaengwattana
intro: If you're visiting the Chaengwattana government complex, running errands around Pak Kret, or just need a clean place to sleep for one night without paying much — Hop Inn Chaengwattana is what budget-minded guests pick most often · It's a 2-star, 108-room hotel from the Erawan Group that sells reliable simplicity: clean rooms, comfy beds, cold air-con and strong hot water at a light price · Guests consistently praise the cleanliness (scored around 9.5), the helpful staff, and the location near the MRT Pink Line at Chaeng Wattana-Pak Kret 28 and CentralPlaza Chaengwattana within walking distance · The trade-offs are no breakfast, no swimming pool, and rooms built for function rather than luxury · Rooms start from approx. ฿900/night.

body.html: Hop Inn Chaengwattana is part of the Hop Inn chain run by The Erawan Group — the largest budget-hotel network in Thailand, with dozens of branches across the country · This branch has 108 rooms and sits on Chaengwattana Road in Khlong Kluea, Pak Kret, Nonthaburi · The appeal of Hop Inn is its standardized simplicity across every branch, so you know exactly what you're getting: a clean room, a firm comfy bed, cold air-con, strong hot water and a price you can actually afford · Anyone who has stayed at another Hop Inn will feel right at home, because the room design and service are almost identical everywhere.

Rooms come in two main types: Standard Double with one large bed, and Standard Twin with two single beds, both around 20 sqm · They're decorated in a bright, simple style with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, a fridge with free drinking water, a work desk and a separate hot-water shower · The thing guests mention most is how clean the rooms are — cleanliness scores around 9.5 — and how comfortable the beds feel for the price · The thing to know in advance is that rooms are built for function, not luxury: there's no kettle or coffee maker in the room, and some reviewers wish there were a hairdryer too · If you need those, pack your own or ask at the front desk.

"Very clean room, comfy bed, helpful staff · free parking in the building and an easy walk to CentralPlaza Chaengwattana · great value for how clean it is — perfect for errands nearby or a one-night stopover."

On facilities, Hop Inn gives you just what you need in line with its budget concept · There's free parking in the building, free Wi-Fi throughout, an in-building convenience store, a 24-hour front desk and a lift · A nice touch many guests like is the free hot drinks — coffee and cocoa — in the lobby in the morning · Security is handled well with keycard building access, CCTV and security staff · What you need to understand before booking is that there's no breakfast, no swimming pool and no fitness room — but there are plenty of restaurants and shops around the hotel, plus a 7-Eleven nearby, so food is never a problem.

Location is a real strength of this branch · It's in the Chaengwattana-Pak Kret area, about 500 m from the MRT Pink Line at Chaeng Wattana-Pak Kret 28 station, which makes getting into Bangkok by train far easier than it used to be for hotels out here · CentralPlaza Chaengwattana — with its mall, cinema and full range of restaurants — is about an 8-minute walk · It's close to the Chaengwattana government complex, Sukhothai Thammathirat Open University and Software Park, handy if you're here for official business or work · Don Muang Airport is around 8 km away, roughly 15–20 minutes by car · The overall score sits around 9.2 from real guest reviews, which is very high for a 2-star hotel and reflects how clean and good-value it is.

Honestly, Hop Inn Chaengwattana is the best-value pick if you want a clean room at a light price in the Chaengwattana area and don't need fancy facilities · For official business, errands, an early Don Muang flight, or a stopover en route, getting a clean room with a comfy bed and free parking for around ฿900 is rare value · But if you want a swimming pool, breakfast, or a bigger room with a view, a 3–4 star property like Best Western Plus Wanda Grand or Riverine Place suits better even at a higher price · And if your goal is full days of sightseeing in central Bangkok, a place along the BTS Green Line or in the city may be more convenient, even though the Pink Line helps a lot now.

A tip from following the reviews here: if you have an early flight from Don Muang, this branch is a good base — it's close to the airport and has free parking · just allow extra time for Chaengwattana Road traffic in the morning · Pack your own kettle or hairdryer if you need them, since the room has neither · The free hot drinks in the lobby run until mid-morning, so come down early if you sleep in · To head into the city, take the Pink Line from Chaeng Wattana-Pak Kret 28 to skip the road traffic · And compare prices across Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before every booking, since each platform runs different deals at different times.

honestSummary: Hop Inn Chaengwattana is the best-value pick in Nonthaburi if you want a clean room at a light price in the Chaengwattana area, are here for errands or a stopover, and don't need fancy facilities · The cleanliness (scored around 9.5), comfy beds, free parking and location near the Pink Line and CentralPlaza Chaengwattana are genuine strengths — but you have to accept there's no breakfast, no swimming pool, and no kettle or hairdryer in the room.
honestChecks: If you want a swimming pool, breakfast, or a bigger room with a view — Hop Inn is a simple 2-star without any of those → Best Western Plus Wanda Grand or Riverine Place in the same area give you more, even at a higher price.
If you need a kettle, coffee maker or hairdryer in the room — this branch doesn't provide them in-room → pack your own or choose a hotel that lists these amenities.

If your goal is full days of sightseeing in central Bangkok — Chaengwattana is on the outskirts and the road gets congested at rush hour → the Pink Line helps, but a place along the BTS Green Line in the city is more convenient if you go out every day.

faq.q: Where is Hop Inn Chaengwattana, and is it near the MRT Pink Line?
faq.a: It's at 1/79 Moo 4, Chaengwattana Road, Khlong Kluea, Pak Kret, Nonthaburi · It's about 500 m from the MRT Pink Line at Chaeng Wattana-Pak Kret 28 station and roughly an 8-minute walk to CentralPlaza Chaengwattana · It's near the Chaengwattana government complex and Sukhothai Thammathirat Open University, and about 8 km (15–20 minutes by car) from Don Muang Airport.

faq.q: How much does Hop Inn Chaengwattana cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rooms start from approx. ฿900/night for a Standard Double with one large bed · There's also a Standard Twin with two single beds for friends or travel companions who want separate beds, at around 20 sqm · Rates climb a little during long weekends or local events, so booking ahead and comparing platforms is recommended.

faq.q: Does Hop Inn Chaengwattana have breakfast and a swimming pool?
faq.a: There's no breakfast and no swimming pool, in line with Hop Inn's budget concept · However, there are free hot drinks — coffee and cocoa — in the lobby in the morning, and the hotel is surrounded by restaurants, shops and a 7-Eleven · CentralPlaza Chaengwattana, with a full range of restaurants, is about an 8-minute walk away.

faq.q: Who is Hop Inn Chaengwattana best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for guests who want a clean room at a light price in the Chaengwattana area — visiting the government complex, running errands around Pak Kret, or stopping over before an early Don Muang flight · It has free parking and is near the Pink Line · If you want a swimming pool, breakfast or a bigger room with a view, a 3–4 star property like Best Western Plus Wanda Grand or Riverine Place suits better.

faq.q: What's provided in the room at Hop Inn Chaengwattana?
faq.a: Rooms have air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, a fridge with free drinking water, a work desk and a hot-water shower · One thing to know is that there's no kettle, coffee maker or hairdryer in the room — pack your own or ask at the front desk if you need them · There's free Wi-Fi throughout, an in-building convenience store, and keycard access with CCTV.
